name: Globe/Temco Swift
variants: Temco / Univair Swift with larger engines
summary: All-metal two-seat, low-wing sport plane with retractable main gear and a tailwheel; a sleek postwar fighter-like lookalike from Texas.

wings: Straight, tapered wing with rounded tips
engines: Single small flat-four or flat-six in a slim, tightly cowled nose
fuselage: Slender fuselage with two seats side by side under a long, sloping canopy
Retractable main gear with a fixed tailwheel

tellTales: Compact, sleek low-wing two-seater with a long, sloping canopy
Tight, short cowl and a tall fin

confusedWith.howToTell: The Swift is a small two-seater with a tailwheel and a swept-back fin; the Mooney is a four-seater with tricycle gear and a forward-swept fin.
The Swift is a smaller two-seater with a tailwheel; the Navion is a four-seater with a long canopy and tricycle gear.
The Swift has a single fin, retractable gear and a tailwheel; the Ercoupe has a twin-fin tail and fixed tricycle gear.
